title: Addit - AI Call Recording & Transcription App
description: Privacy-first mobile app that automatically records, transcribes, and extracts actionable insights from phone calls and voice recordings - all processed locally on device.
longDescription: A privacy-first React Native mobile app that captures and organizes your conversations intelligently. Features automatic call recording in background, AI-powered transcription in 90+ languages with speaker diarization, and smart extraction of calendar events, tasks, reminders, and follow-ups. Everything stays on your device with 100% local storage - you provide your own API keys for AI services. Available on both iOS App Store and Google Play.
